def load_jsonl(path):

def set_seed(seed):

    torch.manual_seed(seed)
    if torch.cuda.is_available():
        torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)


def prepare_data(strategy, seed):

    indices = list(range(len(all_texts)))
